nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The speaker is on. Up close, that isn’t just a hum.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Someone starts to say something. A few more voices come in over the top.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: You can hear it here too? I used to learn my vocab under it. Kept thinking it was my turn to read.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: It cuts out. You’d been waiting for a surname.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The trolley’s parked square. One caster’s still turned out.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: There’s barely room to open the cupboard even without the trolley. This is where it gets parked.

nodes.speaker: q
nodes.text: Don’t put it away for them. I did it once and they said it was my job from then on.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A row of white exercise-book edges in the cupboard. You’d have to pull one out to find a name.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: There’s a join in the rail. One side sits a little higher under your palm.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Both rims are visible from here. The near one covers part of a painted line. The far one covers nothing.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Nobody comes to fetch the ball. You look at the edge of the court again. There wasn’t a ball.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: Stood at the rail during the break. Both rims are visible from there.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The tab catches at either end. What would you look for on the way back?

choices.text: Slide it towards the glass doors.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The glass doors, then. You can see those from the street. Count the floors once you’re inside.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: Under the two 01s, I moved the tab towards the glass doors.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Anyone can find the doors. For the room you just left, it’s that first flight up you need to find.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: Under the two 01s, I moved the tab towards the stairs.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A little warmth from your finger on the tab. Leave it there.
